cases.normative_justification: The title is explicitly introduced by titled. The names in the two-author note do not establish a mandatory authorship filter. Uncertain bibliographic recollection alone neither leaves an intended filter unresolved nor establishes a conflict. There is no unfinished operand or required unsupported field, so the original candidate pair is EXECUTABLE / true.
